## What changed

Describe the research change.

## Evidence

List the strongest supporting sources and explain what each establishes.

## Limits

Describe conflicting evidence, uncertainty, exclusions, or claims that became weaker.

## Checks

- [ ] Consequential claims have nearby citations.
- [ ] Source links open and support the exact wording.
- [ ] No private information or downloaded source artifact is included.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-public-research.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` passes.
